title: The Christmas Consultant
description: A workaholic mother (Caroline Rhea) hires a popular consultant (David Hasselhoff) to get her family through the holidays all in one piece.

title: The Holiday Fix Up
description: When Sam, an interior designer, returns home during the holidays to help renovate the Bell Harbor Inn, she gets paired with Coop as her contractor. The only problem - he's the guy who broke her heart, and she's the one who got away.
